single_dev_capacity_and_scope_reduction_.reality: A solo developer cannot simultaneously maintain a distributed WebRTC mesh, complex media pipelines, and 24/7 manual moderation.
cut_scope_and_freezes: Music Tab Sharing is frozen as an experimental desktop-only toy with zero support commitments.
Multi-channel room creation, direct messaging (DMs), and custom stickers are deprioritized until safety gates pass.
Development resources are 100% focused on stranger matching stability, spectator safety, and automated reporting.

redis_streams_matching_architecture.why_not_pub_sub: Redis Pub/Sub is fire-and-forget. If a worker crashes after receiving a match event but before establishing the WebSocket room handshake, the match is permanently lost with no retry trail.
handshake_protocol: 1. Worker A enqueues user to Stream (XADD stream:matching * publicId 7368 gender male lookingFor female).
2. Matchmaker Consumer Group reads pending items with XREADGROUP GROUP matchers.
3. When compatibility is matched, atomic Lua script moves both users to an active room record in Redis.
4. Both user sockets receive match_found event. Upon mutual client acknowledgment (ACK), the stream item is acknowledged via XACK.
5. If a client fails to ACK within 5 seconds, the item is reclaimed by another worker via XAUTOCLAIM.

voice_audio_buffer_sizing_and_crypto_mat.specification: Rolling 30-second encrypted audio buffer per participant stream.

bandwidth_and_memory_sizing.audio_codec: Opus narrowband/wideband speech at 24 kbps (~3 KB/sec).
bandwidth_and_memory_sizing.scale_calculation_1000_rooms: 1,000 active 2-person rooms = 2,000 active streams. Total RAM required = 2,000 * 90 KB = 180 MB RAM total.
bandwidth_and_memory_sizing.conclusion: Memory footprint is extraordinarily lightweight. 180 MB can comfortably run inside a standard 1 GB container.

cryptographic_overhead.cpu_cost: Modern x86/ARM CPUs with hardware AES-NI instructions encrypt 90 KB of buffer data in under 2 microseconds. CPU overhead is negligible (< 0.1% total worker utilization).

hard_platform_limits.desktop_chromium: Full support (Google Chrome, MS Edge, Brave, Opera) via navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ audio: true }).
hard_platform_limits.desktop_firefox: Partial support (requires system audio capture permission).
hard_platform_limits.desktop_safari: Unsupported (Apple WebKit sandbox blocks tab audio capture).
hard_platform_limits.mobile_browsers: Strictly unsupported on all iOS and Android browsers (mobile OS sandboxes forbid tab audio loopback).

tab_audio_platform_constraints.ui_degradation_strategy: The 'Share Tab Music' button detects browser userAgent and capabilities. On unsupported platforms, the button is cleanly disabled with an informative tooltip: 'Tab audio sharing is only supported on Desktop Chrome/Edge'.

metrics_pipeline.collector: Prometheus scraping /metrics endpoint on backend port 3000.
core_metrics: cordit_reports_total{reason, severity}: Counter tracking filed abuse reports
cordit_voice_seconds_total: Counter tracking WebRTC egress duration

observability_and_abuse_alerting.real_time_alerting: Alertmanager webhooks triggering high-priority Slack/Discord/PagerDuty alerts when any room experiences >= 3 report submissions within 60 seconds, triggering automated room quarantine.
